violation_type.title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)
violation_type.short_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device
violation_type.typical_finding: An infant was observed sleeping in a swing.

finding_variants.text: An infant was observed sleeping in a swing.

Two infants were observed sleeping in a swing.  When caregivers were asked how long the infants had been sleeping in the swings, it was said to be 10 minutes.    NOTE:  Caregivers moved the children to their assigned cribs.
During the walkthrough of the facility, a four month old infant was asleep in a bouncer seat. The caregiver stated the infant had been asleep in the bouncer seat for 10 minutes.
An infant was observed at inspection asleep in a restrictive device.
Observed one infant sleeping in a car seat and observed another infant sleeping in a bouncy seat. This was corrected when both children were removed from the restrictive devices and placed in cribs.
Two infants were observed sleeping in swings. The caregiver said the children had been sleep for 20 minutes. Children may not sleep in restrictive devices. This was corrected at inspection.
